instances.description: Number of Postgres instances. Two is the smallest that survives losing one.

size.description: Volume size per instance, capped at 5Gi. Every replicated storage class puts a full copy on each node it spans, out of a 20Gi data disk per dev-cluster node shared with every other volume, and instances multiply this.

class.description: StorageClass. Both are DRBD-replicated; the number is the replica count.

cpu.description: CPU request per instance, capped at 500m — a quarter of a dev-cluster worker's 2 vCPUs, leaving room for the other instances, other tenants and the node's own system pods.

memory.description: Memory request per instance, capped at 1Gi — a third of a dev-cluster worker's 3Gi, so two instances landing on the same node still leaves headroom for the kubelet, Cilium and the CSI node plugin.
